messages:
Maya (Product): Quick async check — anchorboard Q2 OKR quick tally. I'll list milestones below; please reply with one-liners: "shipped" / "slipped" / "needs help" + owner.

• Runtime v2 canary — Jun — shipped last Thu :shipit:
• Private deploy automation — Ravi — slipped (quota/integration)
• Embeddings pipeline perf tuning — Ava — shipped (v1.2) :tada:
• Console rollout docs — Lena — slipped (reviews)

Please drop a short status + next action.

Jun (Eng): Runtime v2 canary — shipped. Canary in eu-west at 50% traffic, p50 latency down 15%. Next: prod roll on Tue 03/30, target 11:00 PT. I'll open the prod-roll ticket.

Ravi (Eng): Private deploy automation — slipped. Blockers: cloud account quotas + missing IAM role mapping. I pinged infra last week, still waiting. Needs help getting quota bumped and final integration test infra.

Ava (Design): Embeddings perf tuning — shipped. We validated embedding vectors against eval set; no regressions. Next: docs update for changelog.

Lena (SRE): Console rollout docs — slipped (2 reviews pending). I can take one review today. For private deploy quotas, I can escalate — open up a support ticket and tag me. infra-bot, can you attach the quota request template?

infra-bot: Attached quota request template: https://internal.redwood/qreq-template. Please fill and set priority=high.

Carlos (Eng): CR ping — PR #4821 (console docs) needs a review from @Jun or @Ava. It's small (docs + example). Can we get eyes today?

Jun (Eng): Ack, will review PR #4821 after standup.

Maya (Product): Thanks. Quick roll call: everyone who marked "slipped" — drop the one blocker and the ask. Ravi — what's the exact ask for infra? Lena — once infra-bot template is filled, can you escalate?

Ravi (Eng): Ask: quota bump to 300 GPUs across accounts + IAM role mapping doc updated. If infra can provision a temp quota we can run the integration tests Thurs.

Lena (SRE): Can escalate once ticket is in. I'll assign to infra rotation and follow up in 2h. :eyes:

Maya (Product): Cool. For planning: Jun, can you confirm prod rollout ETA after review? If all good, we'll mark runtime as shipped in the OKR tracker and move console docs to "in review".

Jun (Eng): Yes. If PRs land today and no regressions in canary by Mon EOD, prod roll Tue AM. I'll post the prod-roll ticket link here.

Maya (Product): Perfect. Thanks all — please keep updates short in this thread so I can sync with execs tomorrow.
